title: The Grunion Run, 2005 · before
logline: The night before the eighth run, Wood on the beach alone checking the tide table nailed to the lifeguard post, and a man in a faded mill jacket far down the sand, walking slowly, from behind. Wood doesn't go closer. The strip doesn't say who.

panels.composition: The beach at dusk. WOOD reading a tide table tacked to a lifeguard post. BARNABY.
